…“He sent me a link which led to a hosting site with a video.”

Ian double-clicked the file. Judging by the resolution, the noise, and the bands crawling across the screen, it was a digitized recording from a VHS tape. In the video, a man stripped to the waist, holding a camera, was filming himself in a mirror up to the neck. Zooming in on his hand in the reflection, the man turned it palm up and showed a strange mark consisting of three small dots enclosed in a circle. “They’re getting closer to each other, see? Oh my God…” the man holding the camera whispered. “I know he’s here, in the house… I can feel him watching me” The man stepped away from the mirror, climbed the stairs to the second floor, then suddenly let out a piercing scream; the camera fell to the floor and the video ended.

Alaska Psychiatric Institute, Anchorage. Patient: Ian Demme, 18 y.o.

Initial Psychological Evaluation

Patient exhibits severe psychological trauma consistent with acute emotional distress following the recent termination of a long-term romantic relationship. Clinical presentation includes profound depression, emotional withdrawal, survivor’s guilt related to the disappearance of five local children, insomnia, and persistent anxiety.

Following the disappearance of the five children in August 2008, Ian Demme was discovered unconscious deep in the woods surrounding Mag Point with a large shard of glass in his left forearm. He had suffered severe blood loss and barely survived. Investigators concluded that the wound had been self-inflicted and ruled the incident a failed suicide attempt brought on by severe psychological trauma (his girlfriend left him abruptly, leaving Mag Point for good). With no evidence to suggest otherwise, Ian was committed to the Alaska Psychiatric Institute for psychiatric evaluation and treatment.

In reality, Ian had never intended to take his own life. The reason behind his actions was an attempt to save an abducted child.

During his stay at the institution, he encountered another patient, August Pruett, a former Army signals operator. Their meeting would become the first thread connecting Ian to the old mystery of the Gray Signal.

Massacre on Calhoun Avenue

Quote from the police report following the mass shooting on Calhoun Avenue:

The shooting on Calhoun Avenue occurred in the aftermath of the August 2008 disappearances, when Faraday Kavanagh, the father of one of the missing children, suffered a psychological breakdown after losing hope that his son would ever be found. After taking a search-and-rescue volunteer hostage and demanding the return of his child, he released the hostage unharmed before opening fire on responding police officers from the second floor of his home with a semi-automatic rifle. The attack left three officers dead and three others seriously wounded before Kavanagh was killed during the ensuing police operation.
